name: Git
description: Git for every other plugin: repo handles (git.service@1), status, diffs from the merge-base, worktrees, staging and commits. Every git call runs async through the proc service.

permissions.git:read: read refs, branches, files and worktrees
permissions.git:revert: put files or hunks back as the base had them
permissions.git:push: push, or delete a remote branch
permissions.git:snapshot: snapshot the folder as a commit, or as a patch
